_comment: Tailwind entropy allowlist — exceptions to governance rules with documented justification.
_docs: See docs/tailwind-governance.md §Allowlist Policy. Every entry requires: rule, file, pattern, reason, reviewer, expires.
_review_cadence: Quarterly. Remove entries that are no longer needed.

entries.reason: Notification unread-count badge. 10px is the canonical badge/micro-label size per docs/ai-behavior.md §UI Governance Anti-Patterns → Typography.
entries.why_safe: Badge-only context. No translated text at this size. Canonical allowed value.

entries.reason: Full-screen gallery overlay must sit above all floating UI (dialogs z-50, sheets z-50). Fixed inset-0 — no conflict with positioned content.
entries.why_safe: Full-screen inset-0 overlay. Cannot overlap other content because it covers the entire viewport. Layer value consistent with Sonner toast layer.

entries.reason: Gallery container needs fixed height for image crop aspect ratio consistency.
entries.why_safe: Gallery is image-only context, not translated text. Locale-agnostic.

entries.reason: Gallery full-size container height. Image-only, not locale-sensitive.

entries.reason: Static gallery frame height for LCP optimization. Needs fixed height to prevent CLS.
entries.why_safe: LCP-critical image container. Changing this height would worsen CLS and Lighthouse scores.

entries.reason: Underline-style report-status filter tab bar (pending/resolved/archived). Labels must stay on one line in a horizontal tab strip. Adding truncate would silently hide translated text; wrapping would break the single-row tab layout.
entries.why_safe: Tab labels are short enum-like status names translated into 4 locales. Albanian/Ukrainian equivalents are short and tested in the horizontal tab strip context.

entries.reason: Favorites type filter tab buttons in a horizontal tab bar. Labels must stay on one line. Adding truncate would silently cut translated label text. Two instances (lines 37 and 52) cover both filter-tab button sites in this component.
entries.why_safe: Horizontal tab-bar filter buttons with short labels (all, listings, collections — ~5-15 chars in all 4 locales). Intentional nowrap in a fixed-height tab strip.
